title: Climbing Stairs
description: Count ways to climb n stairs taking 1 or 2 steps.

data.text: You are climbing stairs. Each time you can take 1 or 2 steps. How many distinct ways to reach the top?

data.title: O(2^n)
O(n) O(n)
O(n) O(1)

data.caption: The space-optimized solution keeps only the last two results because each step depends only on the two previous steps.
